tree.heading: Advisory Council
tree.text: The term “Advisory Council” means the Great Sand Dunes National Park Advisory Council established under section 410hhh–6(a) 1 of this title.

tree.heading: Luis Maria Baca Grant No. 4
tree.text: The term “Luis Maria Baca Grant No. 4” means those lands as described in the patent dated February 20, 1900, from the United States to the heirs of Luis Maria Baca recorded in book 86, page 20, of the records of the Clerk and Recorder of Saguache County, Colorado.

tree.heading: Map
tree.text: The term “map” means the map entitled “Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve”, numbered 140/80,032 and dated September 19, 2000.

tree.heading: National monument
tree.text: The term “national monument” means the Great Sand Dunes National Monument, including lands added to the monument pursuant to this subchapter.

tree.heading: National park
tree.text: The term “national park” means the Great Sand Dunes National Park established in section 410hhh–2 of this title.

tree.heading: National wildlife refuge
tree.text: The term “wildlife refuge” means the Baca National Wildlife Refuge established in section 410hhh–4 of this title.

tree.heading: Preserve
tree.text: The term “preserve” means the Great Sand Dunes National Preserve established in section 410hhh–3 of this title.

tree.heading: Resources
tree.text: The term “resources” means the resources described in section 410hhh of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

tree.heading: Uses
tree.text: The term “uses” means the uses described in section 410hhh of this title.
